reference.kind: stand-in: Boss's prevalence targets for the life class system (docs/design/habitability/life-classes.md 5.2, 9:13 PM EDT 2026-10-28), tier T9, tweak level L3; set from Boss's rule that sentient life is the rarest and from Core 1's timing review (complex cells 2.5, animals 3, civilization 60 Gyr, scale 1.0), not from observation
reference.worlds: stops_before_animals: every terrestrial planet and moon with a life chemistry in whole seeded systems, with the default configuration. The other three measures: the oxygenic ones among them, in systems made around G2V and K5V (GEN.907, Boss 6:04 AM EDT 10-29: the bands are per oxygenic world, Core 1's figures describe oxygenic life)

stops_before_animals.source: the majority (more than half) of life worlds stop at origin, producers or complex cells

reaches_animals.source: about 15 to 35 percent of oxygenic life worlds reach animals (any grade), Core 1's figures of 21 to 33 per 100 for oxygenic life

reaches_sentient.source: no more than 1 to 2 percent of oxygenic life worlds are sentient (Boss: rarest)

sentient_of_animal_worlds.source: always fewer than one in twenty of the worlds that have animals are sentient (animals to civilizations 20 to 40 to 1)
